NULL SERIES: (a) Weimar 1924-28 (stabilization/Goldene Zwanziger): antisemitic rhetoric present (Rosenberg, early NSDAP) at roughly constant low frequency, no acceleration, no turning. (b) US McCarthyism 1947-54: intense dehumanization of communists throughout, but velocity ROSE 1947-50 and FLAT/DECLINED 1951-54 - and indeed the turning (censure, Army-McCarthy Dec 1954) came as velocity FELL. Partially fits: acceleration preceded peak-of-movement 1950, decline preceded demobilization. Correctly directional both times. (c) Post-WWII US anti-communism during detente 1971-79: low flat baseline, no turning, correctly flat. (d) UK interwar 1934-38: significant fascist rhetoric (BUF, ~50k members) but velocity plateaued after 1936 Cable Street and movement demobilized - no turning, correctly flat-after-plateau. SCORE: 3/3 training series show pre-threshold acceleration; 4/4 null cases correctly flat or velocity-declining-into-demobilization. McCarthyism is the cautionary case: acceleration peaked mid-movement, not pre-threshold, showing the indicator can fire early on a movement that then plateaus for 3 years. IMPLICATION: indicator predicts movement trajectory (accelerating movement -> approaching action OR consolidation ceiling), not turning timing alone. Must be paired with a plateau-detector: acceleration sustained >12 months WITHOUT threshold action = McCarthy pattern (movement absorbing itself), downgrade turning-timing weight.
